modes.STATIC: Deterministic repository-data check. A heuristic may HOLD but can never satisfy native review.
modes.RENDER: Requires a clean build and rendered browser evidence; the static generator reports NOT_RUN.
modes.NATIVE: Requires source-bound accountable native-review evidence; automated or heuristic output cannot pass it.
